decisions.reason: The club guide identifies tee 42 at the fairway head beside the pond. The independently published 43 point lies on the pond-side rough in 2017, 2023 and 2025 and is rejected as an exact fairway placement. This disclosed approximate navigation point is chosen in the clearly visible current fairway head, 12.3 m from that published site point; it is not an observed daily marker or a published coordinate.

evidence.note: Separate clear mown tee platform north of the southwest complex beside the path and access junction. Source shows worn playing surface and furniture next to it. Geometry is mowing extent; horizontal accuracy unreported and coloured tee identity is unverified. Visually cross-checked against the corresponding 2025 Lantmateriet orthophoto.

Narrower principal tee mowing surface is distinct in 2025 imagery inside the broader 2024 mown complex. Preserve the independent 1m terrain instead of flattening the whole polygon. Coloured tee identity and daily marker positions remain unassigned.
